muxt documentation

flags:
--query
  shorthand: "q"
  type: string
  default: ""
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "print the lines that hold this text, as path:line: text"

--help:
Prints the documentation pages and example apps embedded in the binary, by path, so the docs for the version you run are readable without the muxt source or a network.

Full reference: muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/documentation.md

Usage:
  muxt documentation [path] [flags]

Aliases:
  documentation, docs, d

Flags:
  -h, --help           help for documentation
  -q, --query string   print the lines that hold this text, as path:line: text

Global Flags:
  -C, --change-directory string   change the working directory
